---
title: "Figure 2A - Antibody detection across SARS-CoV-2 variants"
output: html_document
---

This notebook plots the proportion of cord-blood and infant samples with
detectable antibodies to wild-type SARS-CoV-2 and five variants of concern.
Run `01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsci)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidyr)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))

required_objects <- c(
  "CB_data_persist", "CB_meta_v2", "infant_persist_M2", "infant_meta_M2",
  "infant_persist_M6", "infant_meta_M6"
)
stopifnot(all(vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1))))
```

## 1. Calculate the detectable fraction for each feature

```{r detection-fractions}
sample_blocks <- list(
  make_sample_block(CB_data_persist, CB_meta_v2, "cord", "Infant_gender"),
  make_sample_block(infant_persist_M2, infant_meta_M2, "infant", "Fetal_Sex"),
  make_sample_block(
    infant_persist_M6,
    infant_meta_M6,
    "infant 6 months",
    "Fetal_Sex"
  )
)
detection_data <- do.call(rbind, sample_blocks)

variant_pattern <- paste(
  c(
    "Spike_WT", "RBD_WT", "Spike_alpha", "RBD_alpha",
    "Spike_beta", "RBD_beta", "Spike_delta", "RBD_delta",
    "Spike_gamma", "RBD_gamma", "Spike_omicron", "RBD_omicron"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)
feature_data <- select_serology_features(detection_data, include = variant_pattern)

detection_long <- feature_data %>%
  mutate(sample_type = detection_data$sample_type) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(feature_data)),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "detected"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_type, feature) %>%
  summarize(fraction_detected = mean(detected), .groups = "drop") %>%
  separate(
    feature,
    into = c("antibody", "antigen"),
    sep = "_",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_class = if_else(grepl("^Ig", antibody), "titer", "Fc"),
    antigen_type = if_else(grepl("^Spike", antigen), "Spike", "RBD")
  )
```

## 2. Prepare the four heatmap matrices

```{r heatmap-matrices}
antibody_levels <- list(
  titer = c("IgG", "IgG1", "IgG2", "IgG3", "IgG4"),
  Fc = c("FcRn", "FcgR2AR", "FcgR2B", "FcgR3AV", "FcgR3B")
)
antibody_labels <- list(
  titer = c("Total IgG", "IgG1", "IgG2", "IgG3", "IgG4"),
  Fc = c("FcRn", "FcgR2A", "FcgR2B", "FcgR3A", "FcgR3B")
)
variant_levels <- c("WT", "alpha", "beta", "delta", "gamma", "omicron")
sample_levels <- c("cord", "infant", "infant 6 months")

prepare_heatmap_matrix <- function(data, antigen_type, feature_class) {
  panel <- data %>%
    filter(
      .data$antigen_type == antigen_type,
      .data$feature_class == feature_class
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      antibody = factor(
        antibody,
        levels = antibody_levels[[feature_class]],
        labels = antibody_labels[[feature_class]]
      ),
      variant = factor(sub(".*_", "", antigen), levels = variant_levels),
      sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = sample_levels),
      column = paste(sample_type, variant, sep = "-")
    ) %>%
    arrange(antibody, variant, sample_type) %>%
    select(antibody, column, fraction_detected) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = fraction_detected)

  matrix_data <- as.data.frame(panel)
  rownames(matrix_data) <- matrix_data$antibody
  as.matrix(matrix_data[, -1, drop = FALSE])
}

panel_specifications <- data.frame(
  antigen_type = c("Spike", "Spike", "RBD", "RBD"),
  feature_class = c("titer", "Fc", "titer", "Fc"),
  title = c(
    "Spike Total IgG and IgG Subclass",
    "Spike Fc Receptors",
    "RBD Total IgG and IgG Subclass",
    "RBD Fc Receptors"
  )
)

heatmap_matrices <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(panel_specifications)), function(i) {
  prepare_heatmap_matrix(
    detection_long,
    panel_specifications$antigen_type[i],
    panel_specifications$feature_class[i]
  )
})
```

## 3. Build the heatmaps

```{r build-heatmaps}
detection_colors <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.5, 1),
  c("#1207A3", "#FFFEFE", "#BB0103")
)
sample_colors <- ggsci::pal_npg()(4)[2:4]
names(sample_colors) <- c("C", "2 m.", "6 m.")
variant_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "Set2")[2:7]
names(variant_colors) <- c("WT", "Alpha", "Beta", "Delta", "Gamma", "Omicron")

make_heatmap <- function(matrix_data, title) {
  column_parts <- strsplit(colnames(matrix_data), "-")
  annotation <- data.frame(
    Type = factor(
      vapply(column_parts, `[`, character(1), 1),
      levels = sample_levels,
      labels = c("C", "2 m.", "6 m.")
    ),
    antigen = factor(
      vapply(column_parts, `[`, character(1), 2),
      levels = variant_levels,
      labels = names(variant_colors)
    )
  )

  top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = annotation,
    which = "col",
    border = TRUE,
    gp = grid::gpar(col = "black"),
    simple_anno_size = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
    col = list(Type = sample_colors, antigen = variant_colors)
  )

  Heatmap(
    matrix_data,
    name = "% Ab",
    col = detection_colors,
    top_annotation = top_annotation,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12),
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    column_split = annotation$antigen,
    border_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2),
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    column_title = title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold"),
    width = ncol(matrix_data) * grid::unit(10, "mm"),
    height = nrow(matrix_data) * grid::unit(15, "mm")
  )
}

heatmaps <- Map(
  make_heatmap,
  heatmap_matrices,
  panel_specifications$title
)
```

## 4. Save Figure 2A panels

```{r save-heatmaps}
invisible(lapply(seq_along(heatmaps), function(i) {
  grDevices::postscript(
    output_path("Figure_2", paste0("Figure_2A_heatmap_", i, ".eps")),
    height = 30,
    width = 14,
    horizontal = FALSE,
    onefile = FALSE,
    paper = "special"
  )
  draw(
    heatmaps[[i]],
    heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
    annotation_legend_side = "bottom"
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()
}))
```
